source.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

review_scope: Numbered Parts 1 to 4 of the dated manual only. Part 1 generally covers sketches, Surveyor Sketches and survey plans; Part 2 adds sketch content, Part 3 survey content, and Part 4 conditional activity content. All scope, exceptions and notes are human review guidance, not machine applicability or extensions to selected rules. External standards and current authority remain unverified.

clauses.summary: Prepare an original computer-drafted plan with accurate scale, readable organization, and clear uncluttered presentation.
Make the proposed activity and its intended purpose clear on the plan.
Keep the sheet between letter size and the stated maximum dimensions.
exceptions: Regulator-approved exception may exceed 75 cm width or 300 cm length.
review_notes: At least letter size.
At most 75 cm wide and 300 cm long without exception.

clauses.summary: Use a listed main-plan scale unless a documented exception applies.
exceptions: A scale specifically allowed elsewhere in the manual may be used.
Regulator may grant a scale exception.
Congested-area details may use any scale or be not to scale.
review_notes: Part 4 permissions depend on activity; they are not general scale permissions.

clauses.summary: Limit multi-sheet plans to the permitted disposition context.
exceptions: MSLs may have multipage plans.
Part 4 may provide specific exceptions.
review_notes: Do not infer a general multipage permission from a long linear activity or any multi-polygon permission.

clauses.summary: Keep separate linear segments off a shared plan unless an exception applies.
review_scope: Multiple non-contiguous segments of a linear activity.
exceptions: Regulator-granted exception.
Applicable Part 4 exception, including conditional mixed public/non-public linear presentations.

clauses.summary: Keep separate non-linear activities off a shared plan unless an exception applies.
review_scope: Multiple non-contiguous non-linear activities, with or without access.
exceptions: Regulator-granted exception.
Applicable Part 4 exception.

clauses.summary: Ensure every text item is readable at the intended plot scale.
Leave a blank 1 cm border margin and crop any excess margin.
review_notes: No information in the margin.

clauses.summary: Identify the plan category in the heading.
exceptions: Compiled plans are explicitly exempt under 3.6.1.1; their heading is governed by 3.6.1.2.
review_notes: Use Sketch, Surveyor Sketch, or Survey for applicable plans.

clauses.summary: Align the stated plan purpose with the applicable PLAR table purpose and activity.
review_notes: The activity/table row must be supplied and reviewed; a purpose keyword alone cannot select a row or plan type.

clauses.summary: State the complete land description, with applicable theoretic and road-allowance wording.
review_notes: Include Within and applicable theoretic qualifier.
Include ATS components and applicable lot, block, and plan.
Include affected south/west road allowances in their section description.
Include adjoining theoretic road allowance wording when applicable.

clauses.summary: Match both heading description and illustrated activity extent to the accompanying form.
review_notes: Requires the application, amendment, or renewal form; plan text alone cannot establish agreement.

clauses.summary: Give the municipality's full legal name.
Match the applicant's legal name to both the client registry and the form.
The preparing consultant or survey company may be identified.
Display both a numerical main-plan scale and a graphic scale bar.
exceptions: Detail views have a separate scale-bar exemption in 1.3.7.2.

clauses.summary: Explain plan symbols and abbreviations in the legend, using standard conventions where practical.
review_notes: Prefer applicable LTO SUR-1 conventions where possible.
Explain all other symbols and abbreviations.
The referenced LTO procedure has not been independently verified in this inventory.

clauses.summary: Keep symbols readable at the intended plot scale.
Include the reference-point symbol and supporting information required for all plan types by the referenced georeferencing guide.
review_notes: External guide contents are outside this supplied-source inventory.

clauses.summary: Indicate plan orientation with north arrows.
Place north toward the top of the sheet when practical.
exceptions: A north-up arrangement is not required where impractical.

clauses.summary: Exclude imagery and keep any colour, shading, topography, or contours from hiding plan information.
review_notes: Imagery is prohibited in the plan.
Permitted graphic treatments must not obscure data.
Using imagery as a source for locating a bank does not permit embedding imagery in the plan.

clauses.summary: Plot the georeferenced point as required by the referenced guide.
review_notes: The georeferencing guide is an unresolved external dependency.

clauses.summary: Plot and label the cadastral framework correctly and show each affected quarter section in full.
Label government road allowances and identify theoretic allowances when applicable.
Label every section or quarter section affected by the activity extent.
Label legal subdivisions or their quarters when they define the activity boundary.
review_scope: LSD or LSD quarter lines are intended activity extents.

clauses.summary: Identify unsurveyed territory in the plan body where the activity lies within it.
Show specified nearby and crossing dispositions, registered boundary surveys, and titled parcels, and check the standing search.
review_notes: Search/display zone: through the activity and within 250 m adjacent.
Identify titled metes-and-bounds parcels as C. of T.
Confirm against the Surface Public Lands Standing Search.
The peat-specific directly-affecting-interests language in 4.3.2.2 needs explicit reconciliation before treating it as a reduced search zone.

clauses.summary: Show relevant water features around and through the activity, indicate flow, and use the stated fallback source where surveyed hydrography is unavailable.
review_notes: Zone: within 100 m adjacent to and through activity.
Include detected unmapped features relevant to regulation.
Fallback: 1:20000 Base Features Hydrography from AltaLIS when surveyed hydrography is unavailable.

clauses.summary: Name the illustrated waterbodies and watercourses where a name applies.
Use a clear solid activity outline substantially heavier than ordinary linework.
exceptions: 4.1.1.3 conditionally allows dashed outline on private land for a continuous mixed-land linear activity.
review_notes: Outline weight: 3 to 4 times normal.
Do not obscure data.

clauses.summary: Exclude surveyed road allowances, registered roads, and public-use unregistered roads from the activity polygon and area.
review_scope: Affected roads fall within the categories listed in the clause.
review_notes: Classify road status from evidence; development or lack of development does not change the surveyed-road-allowance exclusion.

clauses.summary: Include unsurveyed theoretic road allowances in the activity polygon and area.
review_scope: Activity affects theoretic unsurveyed road allowances.

clauses.summary: Define activity edges with straight segments or constant-radius arcs unless a qualifying natural bank forms the boundary.
exceptions: Banks of permanent naturally occurring water features may define a sinuous boundary.

clauses.summary: When the activity follows a natural water bank, document its current location, source, depiction, and applicable prior boundary.
review_scope: Activity extent is intended to coincide with the bank of a permanent naturally occurring waterbody.
review_notes: Use the best available bank evidence; sketches may rely on recent orthorectified aerial/satellite imagery without field verification.
Follow current bank sinuosity and draw it without dimensions.
Use the bank label and give derivation source/date.
On titled upland, ghost the earlier title boundary and identify its derivation.
Continue the bank line approximately 30 to 50 m beyond the activity.
Seek Alberta Land Surveyor advice if flooding or human alteration makes the current bank unclear; this advice is recommendatory within the otherwise required clause.

clauses.summary: Hectare figures may use up to three decimal places and may follow the cited area-rounding convention.
review_notes: Optional precision convention: below 1 ha to 0.001 ha; below 10 ha to 0.01 ha; 10 ha and above to 0.1 ha.
Do not turn optional rounding guidance into a universal precision failure.

clauses.summary: Express plan areas in hectares.
review_notes: This does not prohibit additional acres; 4.3.1.4 requires both units for its specific exploration table.

clauses.summary: State the full activity's total area.
Provide the required forestry assessment area breakdown when confirming Timber Damage Assessment.
review_scope: Area information is being provided for confirmation of Timber Damage Assessment.
exceptions: 4.3.1.5 and 4.3.2.3 waive this breakdown for their SME/RME activity branches.
review_notes: Split total area inside and outside existing dispositions, without parcel-by-parcel fragmentation.
Further split by each affected FMA and outside-FMA area where multiple FMAs or outside-FMA land is affected.
Show incidental activities in a separate row.
For amendments include previously approved area inside existing dispositions.
Treat cancelled dispositions with outstanding obligations as outside existing dispositions.
Do not assume every activity requires a timber-damage assessment without scenario evidence.

clauses.summary: Label the corridor width at every width change.
State lengths by width and the overall length for the specified roads and pipeline agreements.
review_notes: The clause says PLAs; do not silently broaden its literal acronym to every disposition in a pipeline-purpose family.

clauses.summary: Give each detail a unique identifier matching its main-plan reference.
Identify each detail's scale; a graphic scale bar is optional there.
exceptions: No scale bar is required for a detail.
1.1.4 permits congested-area details at any scale or not to scale.
review_notes: Correct detail-scale labeling remains required.

clauses.summary: Keep existing-plan plotting and labels consistent between each detail and the main plan.
Keep detail symbols and dimensions consistent with the main plan.
Show corridor width in each applicable linear-activity detail.
A sketch's reference coordinate may come from one of the listed cadastral, disposition, ATS, control, or existing-survey sources.
review_notes: Listed sources: Cadastral Mapping Database, DIDs, ATS v4.1 coordinates, ASCM, or existing georeferenced disposition survey.
Permission to derive a coordinate from a source does not establish that source's accuracy or satisfy every georeferencing-guide requirement.

clauses.summary: Dimension sketch extents with metre distances, degree bearings, and corresponding curve elements.
exceptions: Apply the specific dimension exceptions in 2.1.1.3, 2.1.1.4, and applicable Part 4 clauses.
review_notes: Horizontal distances at least to 1 m.
Full-circle bearings at least to 1 degree.
Show radius, delta angle, and arc length for each curve at corresponding precision.

clauses.summary: Show approximate distances and directions between deflections, subject to listed existing-line and terminal exceptions.
exceptions: Section, quarter, LSD, LSD-quarter, and adjacent approved-disposition boundaries need not be dimensioned, but sufficient relationship dimensions remain necessary.
A linear activity's ends need not be dimensioned where intent is evident.

clauses.summary: For a narrow parallel corridor, dimension one edge or its parallel alignment.
review_scope: Linear access road or right-of-way with parallel boundaries and width below 150 feet (45.72 m).
review_notes: The stated threshold is strictly below 45.72 m; the clause does not give this simplified treatment at equality.

clauses.summary: Make deflection and terminal points clear, adding symbols or leaders where needed.
Tie each end of the disposition to the nearest ATS corner or a definable point on an existing plan.
Provide at least two suitable ties for every separate segment.
review_scope: Multiple non-contiguous activities are otherwise permitted.
exceptions: Ties may include ties between segments.
review_notes: A tie requirement does not itself authorize a prohibited non-contiguous multi-activity plan.

clauses.summary: Certify a Surveyor Sketch with the prescribed public-lands declaration, signatures, and matching date.
review_notes: Licensed Alberta Land Surveyor signature.
Declaration date consistent with plan version date.
Commissioner for Oaths signature.
The surveyor-sketch-only heading limits applicability; do not require this declaration for an ordinary sketch.

clauses.summary: Include the additional survey-plan information specified by the referenced georeferencing guide.
review_notes: General georeferencing requirements still apply. External guide is not supplied in this inventory.

clauses.summary: Certify the survey plan with the prescribed public-lands declaration, required signatures, and matching date.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
exceptions: Compiled plans use the replacement Appendix D declaration under 3.6.1.3.
review_notes: Licensed Alberta Land Surveyor signature.
Declaration date consistent with plan version date.
Commissioner for Oaths signature.

clauses.summary: Relate the disposition's location to known survey evidence.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
exceptions: Compiled plans exempt from section 3.2.1 under 3.6.1.1.

clauses.summary: Apply the monument types specified by the applicable PLAR table.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
exceptions: Compiled plans exempt from section 3.2.1 under 3.6.1.1.
review_notes: Select a supported table row and preserve monument-code alternatives; the content manual does not determine the applicable row.

clauses.summary: Use non-monumented or computed point categories only where their purpose is clear, recognizing the stated discouragement.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
exceptions: PLAR table entries allowing no monument are excepted.
Compiled plans exempt from section 3.2.1 under 3.6.1.1.
review_notes: The discouragement is not an absolute prohibition. For hybrid plans the stricter calculated/temporary-point prohibition in 3.5.3.4 also applies.

clauses.summary: Show the evidence supporting relationships with all affected dispositions and other interests.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
exceptions: Compiled plans exempt from section 3.2.1 under 3.6.1.1.

clauses.summary: For access roads, identify shared boundaries or parallel overlaps and show common-evidence ties supporting them.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
Access road interacting with another disposition through common boundary or parallel overlap.
exceptions: Compiled plans exempt from section 3.2.1 under 3.6.1.1.

clauses.summary: Dimension survey boundaries at the stated LTO distance, bearing, and curve precision.
review_notes: Horizontal distances in metres to 0.01 m.
Full-circle bearings to 5 arc seconds.
Radius, delta angle, and arc length at corresponding precision.
Compiled plans are not explicitly exempt from 3.2.2 by 3.6.1.1; do not infer that exemption.

clauses.summary: Dimension the ends of linear activities except square terminations.
exceptions: End is 90 degrees to the boundary.

clauses.summary: Identify acquisition date and source for remotely sensed access-road survey data.
review_scope: DLO/LOC access road surveyed using remotely sensed data.

clauses.summary: Follow the referenced natural-boundary submission rules and tabulate verification and direct-observation coordinates.
review_scope: Natural boundary used as a disposition boundary.
review_notes: Comply with referenced change-of-natural-boundary directive and LTO SUR-1 depiction.
Tabulate ground-verification and direct-bank-observation coordinates.
External standards are dependencies, not fully specified by this clause.

clauses.summary: For a qualifying large lease amendment, the existing-boundary survey may be limited and the itemized area must be clearly shown.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
Amendment of previously surveyed DMS/MSL, DML/MLL, DPI/PIL, REC, TCL, or SML lease of at least 10 ha.
exceptions: Only existing-lease boundaries adjacent to the amendment need be surveyed; treat as itemized plan.
Compiled plans exempt from section 3.3 under 3.6.1.1.
review_notes: Bold the full amended-area boundary including its boundary shared with the existing area.
Distinguish existing and amended areas.
The 10 ha threshold concerns the existing lease, as worded; do not substitute amendment area.

clauses.summary: Show improvements and buried infrastructure that affect amended lease boundaries.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
Previously surveyed lease amendment; relevant surface or buried facilities affect amended boundaries.
exceptions: Compiled plans exempt from section 3.3 under 3.6.1.1.

clauses.summary: A long linear disposition with a limited amendment may use an itemized survey of only adjacent existing boundaries.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
Surveyed DPL/PLA, DLO/LOC, or EZE greater than 6.5 km total length; amendment affects no more than two quarter sections.
exceptions: Only boundaries adjacent to amendment need be surveyed; itemized treatment applies.
Compiled plans exempt from section 3.3 under 3.6.1.1.
review_notes: Bold full amendment boundary including shared boundary.
Clearly distinguish old and amended areas.
Source leaves the exactly-6.5-km case unresolved between 3.3.2.1 and 3.3.2.2.

clauses.summary: Retrace a shorter surveyed linear disposition in full where its boundary still applies.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
Previously surveyed linear disposition less than 6.5 km total length, undergoing amendment.
exceptions: Portions that no longer define the boundary need not be retraced.
Compiled plans exempt from section 3.3 under 3.6.1.1.
review_notes: Exactly 6.5 km is not covered by the source's less-than/greater-than wording.

clauses.summary: Retrace the entire disposition when an amendment affects more than two quarter sections.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
Previously surveyed linear-disposition amendment affects more than two quarter sections.
exceptions: Compiled plans exempt from section 3.3 under 3.6.1.1.

clauses.summary: For an itemized addition/deletion, identify changed land, areas, key map, and the complete amended digital polygon.
review_scope: Survey variant review scope: conventional, hybrid.
Adding or deleting land using an itemized survey plan.
exceptions: Colour may be used to illustrate the changed area.
Compiled plans exempt from section 3.3 under 3.6.1.1.
review_notes: Heading states addition/deletion; legal description covers only changed portion.
Illustrate added/deleted areas separately, including both if present.
State added/deleted area and total/remaining area.
Provide key map of changed and total/remaining land.
PCS/OneStop digital polygon includes entire disposition as amended.
Do not amend survey plans using itemized sketches.
The section heading mentions amendments/renewals/as-built surveys, but this numbered clause is specifically conditional on addition/deletion. Do not extend itemized rules to every renewal.

clauses.summary: Use legend-defined unmonumented-point symbols for accepted hybrid coordinates on a conventional plan.
review_scope: Conventional plan interacts with an existing hybrid plan and accepts XCs or RCs.
review_notes: Do not show hybrid symbols in the conventional plan.

clauses.summary: Identify an accepted XC with its source point, plan, disposition, and version.
review_scope: Accepted XC from existing hybrid plan.
exceptions: Identifier order is not prescribed.

clauses.summary: Mark an accepted RC as accepted and provide the same source identifiers used for accepted XCs.
review_scope: Accepted RC from existing hybrid plan.

clauses.summary: Use the applicable PLAR table monumentation for the conventional plan.
review_scope: Conventional plan interacting with existing hybrid plan.

clauses.summary: Identify the survey as hybrid in its heading.
Include the prescribed hybrid statements about governing coordinates, reference system/derivation, ground units, and scale factor.
review_notes: State governing-coordinate status.
Identify UTM zone, NAD83(CSRS), Epoch 2002, and GNSS derivation method.
Identify ground distances in metres.
State combined scale factor to six decimal places.

clauses.summary: Applicable standard hybrid coordinate abbreviations and symbols may be added to the standard legend.
review_notes: Coordinate categories in source table: EC, XC, RC, and OC.
The clause says may; it is not an independent obligation to use every category on every hybrid plan. Coordinate-type fields are separately required by 3.5.2.3.

clauses.summary: Number the coordinate table sequentially from one without gaps or inserted suffix numbers.
Format table northings/eastings to two decimals without grouping spaces or commas.
Identify each tabulated coordinate's EC, XC, RC, or OC category.
Describe each coordinate accurately and identify applicable point attributes.
exceptions: Description wording is otherwise open.
review_notes: Descriptions must agree with the plan.
Identify applicable RP, PC, and CC attributes.

clauses.summary: For existing establishment coordinates, preserve source coordinates and identify their provenance under the new plan numbering.
exceptions: For an unfiled source plan, job and revision numbers may replace the stated source identifiers.
Source identifier order is not prescribed.
review_notes: Use new plan point-number sequence.
Retain exact source northing/easting.
Include original point/plan/disposition/version identifiers.

clauses.summary: Enclose body-of-plan point numbers in ellipses.
Order hybrid point numbers logically from reference points through new boundaries and then other locations.
Natural-boundary OC labels may be thinned on the plan body to avoid clutter while retaining selected table references.
review_notes: Selected point numbers at regular intervals are acceptable.
This is a body-label allowance, not permission to omit necessary coordinates from the table.

clauses.summary: Exclude calculated and temporary points from hybrid plans.
Tabulate curve-end OC/RC identifiers, coordinates, categories, and descriptions for existing curves.
Label point numbers and type symbols for points on the existing curve portions used.
review_scope: Existing curve or portion is used.

clauses.summary: Dimension existing curves with radius, delta, and arc length.
Tabulate point identifiers, coordinates, categories, and descriptions for all points on new curves.
Assign PC/CC attributes to exactly the three curve-defining points in the table descriptions.
review_notes: Placing the attribute first in the description is preferred, not mandatory.

clauses.summary: Label the three defining points of every new curve with point number and coordinate-type symbol.
Dimension new hybrid curves with radius, delta, and arc length.
Show at least one mapping reference point using an allowed physical monument.
review_notes: Permitted RP evidence: found/placed statutory iron post, standard post, found iron bar, or suitable ASCM.

clauses.summary: Show at least two observed coordinates on the hybrid plan.
Keep every establishment, existing-establishment, and re-establishment coordinate within 10 km of an observed coordinate.
Apply the explicit compiled-plan exemptions before selecting heading, monumentation, or amendment checks.
exceptions: Exempt from 1.2.1.1.
Exempt from all 3.2.1 clauses (3.2.1.1 through 3.2.1.5).
review_notes: This does not exempt compiled plans from all Part 1 or all survey content. Part 3 introduction retains general 3.1 to 3.3 obligations except these exemptions; 3.6.1.3 separately replaces 3.1.2 certification.

clauses.summary: Use a heading identifying compilation from existing surveys and its purpose.
Have an Alberta Land Surveyor sign the Appendix D compiled-plan declaration in place of the ordinary survey declaration.
exceptions: Replaces section 3.1.2 declaration requirements.
review_notes: The contents of Appendix D are an external dependency; do not infer additional signatories from the replaced clause.

clauses.summary: Show no new monuments or new fieldwork on a compiled plan.
Explain retained astronomic bearings or identify grid rotations, as applicable.
review_scope: Astronomic bearings retained, or source plans rotated to grid.
review_notes: For astronomic bearings provide appropriate statement and corresponding grid bearing in legend.
For grid bearings identify rotation angle for each rotated plan.

clauses.summary: Use legend-defined annotations for compiled dimensions and rotated bearings.
review_notes: Annotate each compiled dimension.
Annotate each rotated bearing when present.

clauses.summary: Make symbol and annotation usage agree with legend classifications of source dimensions, fixed/calculated values, rotations, and new unmonumented corners.
Depict existing monuments with standard found-evidence symbols and identify that legend class as existing evidence.
Avoid transcribing source-plan monument descriptions; limit any description to applicable ATS location.
Use the specified application/plan route when adding land to an existing EZE/REA.
review_scope: Addition of land to an existing EZE/REA.
review_notes: Source lists new activity number, itemized plan associated with existing plan, and amendment of entire EZE/REA.
The list appears to offer alternative routes but does not explicitly say one of; preserve for reviewer interpretation rather than implementing all three as cumulative obligations.

clauses.summary: Show a VCE continuously or using the permitted separate-shape sketch presentation.
review_scope: VCE activity; the non-contiguous multi-shape alternative specifically describes a sketch.
exceptions: Continuous linear activity and/or non-contiguous multi-shape sketch are permitted.
review_notes: The heading also names RVC, but this clause names only VCE; do not silently extend to RVC or extend the sketch-specific alternative to every survey subtype.

clauses.summary: Choose an allowed presentation for a linear activity spanning public and non-public land.
review_scope: Listed linear-disposition activity spans both public and non-public lands.
exceptions: Show only public-land segments on one sheet in one township.
Show continuously with a dashed outline over private land.
Show the entire activity continuously with a bold outline.
review_notes: These are conditional alternatives to ordinary continuity/outline rules; the one-township condition belongs to the public-segments option.

clauses.summary: Describe only the public-land segments in the heading when using either segmented public-land or dashed private-land presentation.
review_scope: First or second presentation alternative in 4.1.1.3.

clauses.summary: Describe all parcels and label their Crown/Freehold status when bold outlining the entire mixed-land activity.
review_scope: Third presentation alternative in 4.1.1.3: continuous bold extent on public and private land.

clauses.summary: Secure prior regulator approval for a long continuous linear plan that cannot meet sheet-size limits.
review_scope: Long linear disposition drawn continuously cannot satisfy sheet-size limits.
review_notes: This is a prior-approval condition, not an unconditional sheet-size or multipage waiver.

clauses.summary: Limit a multi-polygon piezometer/heave-monument application and its access to a six-mile-square extent unless excepted.
review_scope: Multiple piezometer sites, heave monuments, and associated access in one application.
exceptions: Regulator may grant an exception to the 6 miles by 6 miles application extent.
review_notes: Spatial extent limit is not a numeric area limit in acres/hectares.

The source advises considering amendment consequences; a change to one site may require retracing the entire survey. Treat that as conditional professional review, not an automatic retracement obligation.

clauses.summary: Use a general permitted scale or one of the extra scales allowed for non-peat exploration.
Keep the applicant's new SME application outside the stated separation from its existing SME applications.
review_scope: Non-peat SME application; same applicant has existing SME applications.
review_notes: Separation: not within six miles (9.6 km).
The clause says SME, not all RME or other material activities.

clauses.summary: Use a separate SME/RME number for each contiguous non-peat activity.
exceptions: A surveyed road allowance or registered road splitting the activity may justify an exception.

clauses.summary: Keep non-peat exploration within the stated acreage limit and tabulate exclusions where used.
review_notes: Maximum 320 acres.
When disposition exclusions are applied, tabulate gross extent, exclusions, and resulting net area.
Show each listed area in both hectares and acres.
Do not derive a general acres prohibition from 1.3.6.2; this clause requires both units for the specified table.

clauses.summary: The non-peat exploration area need not use the general timber-assessment breakdown.
exceptions: Waives 1.3.6.4 only; other area-reporting clauses remain.

clauses.summary: Show and label every existing disposition inside the proposed non-peat exploration area.
Mark proposed test holes with a legend-defined symbol.
review_scope: Non-peat SME/RME with proposed test holes.
exceptions: TH, X, or another explained symbol may be used.

clauses.summary: Draw dashed access routes to each proposed test hole.
review_scope: Non-peat SME/RME with proposed test holes.

clauses.summary: Show all watercourse crossings for the non-peat exploration activity.
Contours may be included on a non-peat exploration plan.
review_notes: Source notes AltaLIS Base Features data availability; this does not make contours mandatory in this branch.

clauses.summary: Use an allowed peat-exploration scale and add details or labels if the smaller presentation obscures extent.
review_scope: SME/RME related to peat exploration or extraction.
exceptions: General scales plus 1:20000, 1:25000, and 1:30000 are permitted.
Scale up to 1:40000 is allowed if extent intent remains clear.
review_notes: Use detail views and/or labeling where extent is unclear.

clauses.summary: Show and label specified interests directly affecting the peat-exploration extent.
review_scope: SME/RME related to peat exploration or extraction.
review_notes: Include directly affecting dispositions, titled metes-and-bounds parcels, and LTO-registered boundary surveys.
The clause does not explicitly say it exempts the 250 m general search/display rule in 1.3.3.6; do not silently reduce that zone.

clauses.summary: The peat-exploration area need not use the general timber-assessment breakdown.
review_scope: SME/RME related to peat exploration or extraction.
exceptions: Waives 1.3.6.4 only; other area-reporting clauses remain.

clauses.summary: Use one disposition number for each contiguous non-peat material activity in this branch.
review_scope: SMC/RMC, SML/RML, or DMS activity unrelated to peat and excluding surface-material leases overlapping oil-sands MSLs.
exceptions: A surveyed road allowance or registered road splitting the activity may justify an exception.

clauses.summary: Keep the applicant's new SML application outside the stated separation from its existing SML applications.
review_scope: SML in the non-peat, non-overlapping-oil-sands-MSL branch; same applicant has existing SML applications.
review_notes: Separation: not within six miles (9.6 km).
The clause explicitly says SML; do not automatically extend to RML, SMC/RMC, or DMS.

clauses.summary: Show contours for the surface-material activities in the specified non-peat branch.
review_scope: SMC/RMC, SML/RML, or DMS activity unrelated to peat and excluding surface-material leases overlapping oil-sands MSLs.
review_notes: The source names AltaLIS Base Features as available data; unlike 4.3.1.10, contour inclusion here is required.

clauses.summary: Limit the overlapping surface-material lease to one SML/RML activity per MSL activity.
review_scope: Surface-material lease overlapping an oil-sands mineral surface lease.

clauses.summary: Match the overlapping SML/RML boundary to its related approved MSL boundary.
review_scope: Surface-material lease overlapping an oil-sands mineral surface lease.

clauses.summary: For a qualifying final sketch, use the surveyed MSL boundary and identify its source instead of extent dimensions.
review_scope: Surface-material lease overlapping an oil-sands MSL; submitting a sketch as the final plan.
exceptions: Dimensions along activity extents are not required for this final-sketch branch.
review_notes: Related MSL must be surveyed.
Label coincident extents throughout with MSL number, plan number, and version date.
Scale up to 1:20000 unless regulator grants an exception.
The source explicitly says sketch; whether surveyor_sketch inherits this relief is not resolved here.
Do not apply final-stage relief to other stages or unrelated material plans.

clauses.summary: Use one disposition number per contiguous peat-related activity in the listed material-disposition family.
review_scope: Peat-related SMC/RMC, SML/RML, or DMS activity under 4.4.
exceptions: A surveyed road allowance or registered road splitting the activity may justify an exception.

clauses.summary: Keep a peat-related SML within 500 hectares.
review_notes: The literal SML restriction is not automatically an RML, SMC/RMC, or DMS area limit.

clauses.summary: Show the existing bank, applicable full-supply level, and their determination methods.
review_scope: Wetland-protection or natural-waterbody-reservoir DLO/LOC activity under 4.5.
review_notes: Determine existing bank using imagery and site inspection.
Show FSL where applicable.
Identify methods used for each.

clauses.summary: Place the freehold-land portion of the activity extent at the bank.
